name: v42_customer_spillover_no_authority_unit_clean
hypothesis: O0pNLZxv was strong but collided with customer authority ACTIVE; removing authority and using dimensionless relative-return spread may reduce correlation and unit warning.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_cust, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Authority removed; rel_ret_cust normalized by close to avoid subtract unit warning.

name: v42_customer_spillover_market_neutral_low_authority
hypothesis: MARKET neutralization may reduce collision with industry customer-authority quality alpha while preserving customer spillover signal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Keeps authority at only 15%; tests neutralization as structural decorrelator.

name: v42_customer_spillover_subindustry_clean
hypothesis: Subindustry neutralization may improve sub-universe robustness for the customer-spillover mechanism.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_cust, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: No customer authority; tests finer peer control and systematic-risk relief.

name: v42_customer_partner_spillover_blend
hypothesis: Blending customer and partner return spillover may reduce dependence on the customer-authority graph while keeping related-entity information.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_part / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Partner return was weak alone, but small blend may decorrelate customer return.

name: v42_customer_competitor_relative_spread
hypothesis: Customer strength versus competitor strength may capture demand-chain advantage without customer-authority exposure.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(rel_ret_comp / close, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_cust, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Tests relative network return spread; no authority and no own returns subtraction.

name: v42_customer_spillover_social_confirm
hypothesis: Social sentiment confirmation may replace customer authority as the stabilizer, lowering correlation with RRpmO2xb.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Uses v41 social field only as a stabilizer; social alone was weak.

name: v42_customer_spillover_bfl_growth_confirm
hypothesis: BFL growth may replace customer authority with a lower-crowding stabilizer, even though BFL alone was weak.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_growth, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: BFL as small decorrelating stabilizer; watch coverage/sub-universe.

name: v42_customer_spillover_signal_only_market
hypothesis: A minimal customer-spillover signal with market neutralization can test whether O0pNLZxv's alpha comes from spillover or from authority/risk additives.
expression: 0.70 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust / close, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Signal-only-ish diagnostic; submit only if checks and correlation pass.
